about: World 1 acceptance bands: the rows the Gate reads for a finished Spillway (dam, flume, Brindle). scripts/world1-bands.mjs evaluates them. status gate: a miss or a missing input fails the read. status report: measured and printed but never fails, until the units in enforced_from land and the coordinator flips it to gate. status info: shown, no threshold. Run length lives in the pacing file (source pacing) and the panel band in #398's drop sim; neither is restated here. Thresholds are the integrator ledger's (/mnt/project-files/world1/BUDGETS.md); change a number there first.

bots.measure: the pacing file's measure block (table, stages, seeds, pilots, bot_args, policy_args) is the run recipe; the completionist explores until done with --explore-by=900 as a safety clock (ruling ag)

The yard lock and the Warden clamp sit on the way to the Warden or in its fight, and a parkN cell wins when the Warden is engaged, so neither moves reach; a cell that grades the park clear would see them. Every other cell and column grades against scripts/challenge/lib.mjs TARGETS.
